# prismasdwan_site_ciphers (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Site Ciphers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "site_ciphers".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_site_ciphers" "example" {
  controller_connection_cipher = "RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384"
  site_id                      = "<site_id>"
  vpn_ciphers                  = ["AES_256_GCM"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `controller_connection_cipher` (String) Controller connection cipher. Value: one of RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384, RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `site_id` (String) Site id. Value: at most 50 characters, matching `^-?[0-9]{1,50}$`.
- `tls13_controller_connection_cipher` (String) Tls13 controller connection cipher. Value: one of TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256, TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `tls13_enabled` (Boolean) Tls13 enabled. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `vpn_ciphers` (List of String) Vpn ciphers. At most 4 items. Each item: one of AES_256_GCM, AES_256_CBC, AES_128_GCM, AES_128_CBC.
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String) The Terraform internal identifier for this resource.

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell

terraform import prismasdwan_site_ciphers.example "<resource_id>"
```
